name: Attawapiskat Development Corporation
description: Community-based economic development corporation providing cable television, internet and mobile service support, employment programs and local economic development in Attawapiskat. Distinct from Attawapiskat Enterprises according to the corporation's official FAQ.
ownership_type: Unverified — official organization website describes community ownership
ownership_evidence: The official About page describes ADC as a community-owned organization governed by a board drawn from Attawapiskat First Nation. Ownership has not been independently verified.
on_reserve_location_evidence: The corporation lists an office at 255 River Road, Attawapiskat First Nation, Ontario, on its official About page. Precise legal reserve parcel location remains unverified; no address is reproduced in the public record.
review_notes: Official source reviewed November 1, 2026. All status fields unverified; no residential or precise business addresses published.

name: Black Lake Ventures
description: The Black Lake First Nation website identifies Black Lake Ventures as the Nation's business arm, with investments in Athabasca Basin Development, Prince Albert First Nations Business Development, Athabasca Catering and West Wind Scheduled Services. Operating and ownership status pending direct verification.
ownership_type: Unverified — First Nation website identifies the business as its economic development arm
ownership_evidence: Black Lake First Nation's Economic Development page calls Black Lake Ventures the business arm of the First Nation and lists its ownership interests. This is official community-source evidence, not independent verification.
on_reserve_location_evidence: Black Lake First Nation identifies Black Lake Ventures as its business arm, but its economic development page does not establish a specific business office or legal reserve parcel. On-reserve location remains unverified.
review_notes: Official source reviewed November 1, 2026. All status fields unverified; no residential or precise business addresses published.

name: Waterfound Development Corporation
community: Black Lake Denesuline First Nation (investment partner)
description: Black Lake First Nation reports a 33% ownership interest in Waterfound Development Corporation, which in turn holds a stake in Northern Resource Trucking. Legal operating location and current ownership remain Unverified.
ownership_type: Unverified — official First Nation website reports a 33% ownership interest
ownership_evidence: Black Lake First Nation's official Economic Development page states the Nation participates in Waterfound Development Corporation through a 33% stake. This is evidence of partial Indigenous ownership, not a claim of majority Indigenous ownership.
on_reserve_location_evidence: The official First Nation page identifies a corporate investment, but provides no Waterfound Development Corporation physical office or reserve parcel. On-reserve location is not established and remains unverified.
review_notes: Official source reviewed November 1, 2026. All status fields unverified; no residential or precise business addresses published.
